title: 第11章 集结
content_zh:
第11章 集结
黑夜里，许青身影如猫，敏捷而又悄然无息的前行。
他的手时而抬起按住嘴，强忍着咳嗽的冲动。
这个过程前几次时，还不算什么，但随着许青的移动，随着他多次的克制，渐渐肺部好似火烧一样，让他面色越发苍白。
好在这里距离他的居所不远，而营地又不是很大，所以不多时许青就看到了雷队的小院。
他没有直接冲去，而是站在原地深吸口气，尽可量让自己正常一些，这才放缓了速度，不疾不徐的靠近。
推开竹院的门，许青目光扫过四周，缓步走入小屋中。
在进入屋舍的一刻，许青再也忍不住，哇的一声吐出一口血，此血黑色，落在地上时发出呲呲之声。
随着这口毒血的吐出，许青的面色也从之前的苍白，变的正常了一些，喘着粗气坐在那里，盘膝打坐开始吐纳。
直至半晌后，他才睁开眼，面色彻底恢复过来。
“好烈的毒！”许青喃喃。
胖山最后那口毒雾，其内蕴含的毒性极大。
可当时的情况许青若是避开，对方定然第一时间逃走呼喊，引人注意，到了那个时候，事情的处理就会有些繁杂。
且就算是自己这里摆出受伤的姿态，怕是也很难骗过那狡诈的胖山。
对方自从察觉被跟踪后，所有的行事都很有章法，唯一的失算就是对许青实力错误的评估。
所以，在那关键的时刻，许青选择了相信自己紫色水晶带来的恢复力，强忍着毒雾的侵袭冲杀过去，速战速决，一击将其毙命。
此刻来看，他的选择没错。
紫色水晶对于毒性的侵袭，的确具备很强的恢复。
这一路走来他肺部的颤抖欲咳之感，实际上就是恢复力在起效。
“拾荒者，果然没有一个是简单的，想来那马四若非我出手敏锐，没给他反击的时间，怕是也很难缠。”

许青心底喃喃，开始总结这一次自己的不足之处。
许久，许青深吸口气，低头看向自己的皮袋，眼睛里露出奇异之芒。
“胖山之所以独自一人，是因他窥伺马四的一样物品，所以他准备反向狩猎我，从我身上拿走马四之物。”
许青前。
目光从这些物品上扫过，许青一样样仔细的检查起来。
直至最终，他排除了其他物品，看向那个金属铁块，眉头皱起，有些不确定。
实际上马四的遗物，都很普通，这金属铁块只能说是相对其他物品而言，有些突兀与未知罢了。
“是此物？但似乎也没什么出奇之处，难道是一个很值钱的材料？”
许青想了想，小心的将其收好，准备以后找个机会，探寻一下此物的来历。
随后，他拿出胖山的皮袋，检查一番。
里面白丹没有，但灵币不少，还有很多似有毒的瓶瓶罐罐，许青不懂毒术，不敢轻易
最终他取出那满是裂痕的琥珀，回忆胖山死前抓着的状态。
“此物又是什么……似乎那家伙死前，要捏碎的样子。”许青疑惑，他觉得自己缺少相关知识，思索后将其收好。
做完这些，他双目闭合，继续修行。
这些日子以来，许青发现自己到了凝气二层后，似乎睡觉的时间不需要以往那么久，往往一个时辰左右，就可以恢复精力。
所以大部分时候，他都沉浸在了修炼之中。
更因今日他不需要外出盯梢，所以修行更久，直至一整天过去，夜晚再次降临时，许青似有所察，睁开眼看向屋舍房门外。
在他看去的一刻，那里传来了雷队的声音。
“小孩，来院子里。”
许青闻言坐起，默默的走出，看见了院子内的雷队。

院子中摆放了一张大桌子，上面放着一些肉食与酒水，一共六张椅子，六副碗筷，雷队坐在其中，向着许青招手。
扫了一眼桌子与碗筷，许青心底有所猜测，轻步走去，坐在了雷队的身侧。
“这几天对营地熟悉了么？”雷队望着院子外，神态随意的对许青开口。
“差不多了。”许青回答道，目光扫过桌子上的食物。
或许是一整天的修炼，又或许是食物的香气诱人，很快许青肚子就传出了咕咕声。
一旁的雷队听到笑了笑。
“别急，等一等他们。”
“雷霆小队的人？”许青之前就猜测了一些，此刻问了一句。
老头点了点头，刚要开口，但似乎有所察觉，望向外面，与此同时，许青也心有所感，扫了过去。
院子外，昏暗的街头，出现了一个大汉的身影。
这大汉的魁梧程度超过了当初的残牛，整个人如一座小山，全身肌肉膨胀，带着逼人的气势，背着一面巨大的精钢盾牌，手中拎着堪比许青高度的狼牙棒，迈着大步走来。
每一步落下，都传出砰砰之声，越来越近，直至到了竹门外，随着竹门被推开，大汉惊人的身躯，踏进了院子内。
他的出现，使得院子都似乎变小了一些，其魁梧的身影所带来的气势，更是扩散开来，许青有一种在废墟城池内面对强大异兽的感觉，瞳孔微微收缩。
“头儿，我回来了。”
大汉向着雷队咧嘴一笑，传出闷闷的声音，目光落在桌子上的食物时，眼睛一亮，迈步走近后取下盾牌丢在一旁，又将手里的狼牙棒扔在地上，传出砰砰的两声巨响。
做完这些，他直接就坐了下来，椅子顿时传出惊心动魄的咯吱声，似支撑的极为勉强，而从始至终，他都没有去看许青，仿佛不是很在意。
雷队笑了笑，没说话，那大汉盯着食物，也没动手，默默等待。
至于许青，则是望着地面上的盾牌与狼牙棒。
从方才的声响他可以基本判断出，这两样物品的重量，恐怕……都远超自己的体重。
时间不久，在这院子内的安静中，竹门外的街头，出现了两道身影，一男一女。

男的是个青年，背着一把长弓，身影挺拔，唯独脸上有一道十字疤痕，好似被人强行刻上，触目惊心的同时，他的眼睛格外的锐利。
至于那女子，三十多岁的样子，相貌寻常，但身姿在一身紧致的皮衣下，却很火爆，弥漫了一种原始的诱惑。
二人走入竹院，冲着雷队打了招呼后，坐在椅子上时，那背弓的青年看了许青一眼，似在审视。
其旁的女子则目露好奇，声音带着一些娇媚，笑着开口。
“头儿，怎么我们出去一趟，你就多了一个孩子？老当益壮呦头儿，莫非这次你喊我们回来，是要告诉大家，你在外面瞒着我们留了个种？”
“年纪不对。”魁梧大汉闷闷开口。
许青没说话，左脚微微挪开，使小腿绑着的匕首，可以更顺利的被取出，他有些不安，这到来的三人，每一个给他的感受都很强。
比昨日的胖山，还要更强一些。
尤其是那个背弓之人，甚至都隐隐给了许青一种针芒在背之感。
“蛮鬼，炼体三层，天生神力。”雷队没去理会他们的戏言，看了眼许青，一指魁梧大汉。
“鸾牙，凝气三层，能与凶兽沟通，这营地里你看到的野狗，大都是她的耳目。”
“十字，凝气四层圆满，同境难有对手。”雷队向着许青一一说完，又当着他们三人的面，指了指许青。
“小孩，炼体二层。”
随着雷队的开口，小队的三人都神色肃然了不少，许青坐在一旁，认真在听。
“先吃东西，边吃边说。”目光扫过四人，雷队淡淡开口，夹起一块小肉，吃了下去。
“这一次提前喊你们回来，是因今年的春收提前了，营主发布了一个任务，对于七叶草除了原本的收购价格外，最多的一方，将额外给予三枚效果远超白丹的清尘丹！”
“我们在禁区里藏着的那块地，可以提前去采摘了，你们的意见呢？”雷队话语一出，蛮鬼三人目中都有精芒，彼此看了看后，都点了点头。
许青没听过清尘丹，可雷队的话语里说的很清晰，此丹比白丹，效果更好。
“你们既同意，就准备一下吧，此番进禁区，小孩跟着。”雷队缓缓说道。
“他？”蛮鬼三人看向许青。

十字那里，眉头微微一皱。
“头儿，炼体二层太弱了，我们完成任务之余还要对其照顾的话，有些不妥。”
“谁都有第一次。”雷队扫过十字，随后看向许青。
“小孩，你自己决定。”
“我可以。”许青点了点头。
他口袋里白丹还有五粒，对于清尘丹的需求不是很大，可他明白生活在拾荒者营地内，禁区是早晚必然要去的，既如此……与经验丰富的小队一同，自然能学到更多。
十字沉默，不再说话。
“你们吃完就散了吧，明日一早，于此地汇合，我们出发！”雷队说完，起身回了屋舍。
许青也戳了一大块肉，咽下后看了眼三人，快步走回房间，他不想留在那里，对于陌生人，许青的警惕感始终存在。
一夜无话，许青的准备工作没有太多，因为他的习惯，使得他随时随地都处于可以迅雷出手的程度。
于是在第二天清晨，在雷队的带领下，他们一行五人从营地内走过。
蔚蓝的天空，阳光明媚。
半空中有一只鹰绕着营地盘旋，似在凝望，而他们的身影，也引起四周拾荒者的瞩目。
似乎是因蛮鬼的身躯异常高大，再加上鸾牙的身姿妙曼，所以就连前几天到来停留在这里的车队，也有人向他们看去。
车队处，拾荒者更多，他们很难得的在那里排着队伍，仿佛在等待。
许青昨日一整天没外出，不知晓那里发生了什么，此刻目光扫过时，一旁的鸾牙笑着开口。
“昨晚我就听人说起，这车队来自紫土，里面有个郎中医术似乎很高明的样子，昨天把瘸豺那老色鬼的腿伤都治好了，于是很多人就排队前去看伤。”
“这郎中一定赚了不少。”蛮鬼在旁听闻，羡慕的闷声道。
许青也羡慕，遥遥的看了眼，收回目光的一瞬，他的眼睛忽然微凝。
不仅是他，蛮鬼与鸾牙也是目光刹那锐利，唯有十字与雷队，神色如常，可若仔细去看，能看到他们的目中都有了寒意。

因为，在他们一行人的前方，另一支小队正在那里汇聚成员。
这小队差不多七八人，有男有女，每一个身上都带着凶残之意。
尤其是里面的一个与雷队一样的老者，被众人簇拥。
他披头散发，眼睛里带着嗜血，此刻坐在一只野狗的尸体上，生吃狗腿的同时，传出阴冷的话语。
“去给我将马四与胖山这两个杂种找出来，出发的时间竟敢迟到，他们是活腻歪了。”
正是血影小队！
那吃着生肉的老者，显然就是血影小队的队长。
一身灵能波动肆无忌惮的外放开来，使听到其话语的许青，微微眯眼，盖住目中的芒。
而鸾牙在看到血影队长手中的肉以及身下的狗尸后，眼睛里刹那就有强烈的愤怒与杀机弥漫，那是她的狗。
与此同时，血影小队也看到了雷队一行人，坐在狗尸上的老者，咧嘴一笑，冲着鸾牙舔了舔舌头。
“小骚蹄子，你养的狗，肉质不错，不知道你身上的肉，味道如何。”
昨天晚上码完字，终于跑出去找到一家算是堂食的餐厅，吃了顿梦寐以求的潮汕牛肉火锅，3个月了第一次吃到，幸福满满。
新书需要支持，我负责码字写好作品，其他就拜托大家啦。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 11 Gathering
In the dark night, Xu Qing's figure was like a cat, moving forward quickly and quietly.
From time to time his hand would be raised to cover his mouth, resisting the urge to cough.
The first few times this process happened, it was nothing, but as Xu Qing moved and as he restrained himself many times, his lungs gradually felt like they were on fire, making his face paler.
Fortunately, it was not far from his residence, and the camp was not very big, so Xu Qing saw Team Lei's small courtyard soon.
He did not rush directly, but stood there and took a deep breath, trying to be as normal as possible, then slowed down and approached unhurriedly.
Pushing open the door of the bamboo courtyard, Xu Qing glanced around and walked slowly into the hut.
The moment he entered the house, Xu Qing could no longer hold back and spat out a mouthful of blood. The blood was black and made a squelching sound when it fell to the ground.
As the mouthful of poisonous blood was spit out, Xu Qing's complexion became a little normal from the previous paleness. He sat there panting heavily, sat cross-legged and meditated and began to vomit.
It wasn't until a long while that he opened his eyes and his expression completely recovered.
"What a powerful poison!" Xu Qing muttered.
The poisonous mist at the end of Fat Mountain contains extremely poisonous content.
But if Xu Qing avoided the situation at that time, the other party would definitely run away and shout immediately, attracting attention. At that time, the matter would be a bit complicated to deal with.
And even if he showed an injured posture, it would be difficult to deceive the cunning Fat Mountain.
Since the other party realized that he was being followed, everything he did was very orderly. The only miscalculation he made was his wrong assessment of Xu Qing's strength.
Therefore, at that critical moment, Xu Qing chose to believe in the resilience brought by his purple crystal, endured the invasion of the poisonous mist, rushed over, and killed him quickly with one blow.
At this moment, it seems that he made the right choice.
Purple crystal does have a strong recovery ability against toxic attacks.
The trembling and coughing feeling in his lungs along the way was actually the recovery power taking effect.
"Sure enough, none of the scavengers are simple. I think Ma Si would have been very difficult to deal with if I hadn't been sharp and given him time to fight back."
Xu Qing murmured in his heart and began to summarize his shortcomings this time.
After a long while, Xu Qing took a deep breath and looked down at his leather bag, with a strange light in his eyes.
"The reason why Fat Shan is alone is because he is spying on something belonging to Ma Si, so he is planning to hunt me in reverse and take Ma Si's belongings from me."
Xu Qingqian.
Looking over these items, Xu Qing inspected them carefully.
Until finally, he eliminated other items and looked at the metal piece, his brows furrowed, a little unsure.
In fact, Ma Si's relics are very ordinary. This metal iron block can only be said to be a bit unexpected and unknown compared to other items.
"Is it this? But it doesn't seem to be anything surprising. Could it be a very valuable material?"
Xu Qing thought for a while and carefully put it away, preparing to find an opportunity in the future to explore the origin of this object.
Then, he took out Fat Shan's leather bag and checked it.
There is no white elixir in it, but there are a lot of spirit coins, and there are many bottles and jars that seem to be poisonous. Xu Qing doesn't know the poison technique and doesn't dare to take it easily.
Finally, he took out the cracked amber and recalled the state in which Pang Shan held it before he died.
"What is this thing... It seems that the guy was going to crush it before he died." Xu Qing was confused. He felt that he lacked relevant knowledge, so he put it away after thinking.
After doing this, he closed his eyes and continued practicing.
Over the past few days, Xu Qing found that after arriving at the second level of Qi Condensation, it seemed that he didn't need to sleep as long as before. He could usually regain his energy in about an hour.
So most of the time, he was immersed in cultivation.
Because he didn't need to go out to keep an eye on him today, he practiced even longer. Until the whole day passed and night fell again, Xu QingSeemingly aware of something, he opened his eyes and looked outside the door of the house.
The moment he looked, the voice of Team Thunder came from there.
"Kid, come to the yard."
Xu Qing sat up after hearing this, walked out silently, and saw the Lei team in the yard.
A large table was placed in the yard, with some meat and wine on it. There were six chairs and six pairs of bowls and chopsticks. Captain Lei sat on it and waved to Xu Qing.
Glancing at the table and bowls and chopsticks, Xu Qing made a guess in his heart, walked over lightly, and sat next to Captain Lei.
"Have you become familiar with the camp these days?" Lei Dui looked outside the yard and asked Xu Qing casually.
"Almost." Xu Qing replied, looking at the food on the table.
Perhaps it was the whole day of practice, or perhaps it was the enticing aroma of the food, but Xu Qing's stomach soon began to growl.
Team Lei on the side heard and laughed.
"Don't worry, wait for them."
"People from the Thunder Team?" Xu Qing had made some guesses before and asked now.
The old man nodded and was about to speak, but seemed to notice something and looked outside. At the same time, Xu Qing also felt something and glanced over.
Outside the yard, on the dim street, a figure of a big man appeared.
This big man was more burly than the original Canniu. His whole body was like a hill, his muscles were swollen, and he was carrying an intimidating momentum. He was carrying a huge stainless steel shield on his back, and was holding a mace comparable to Xu Qing's height as he strode forward.
With each step, there was a banging sound, getting closer and closer, until they reached the outside of the bamboo door. As the bamboo door was pushed open, the big man's astonishing body stepped into the courtyard.
His appearance made the courtyard seem smaller, and the aura brought by his burly figure spread even more. Xu Qing had the feeling of facing a powerful beast in the ruined city, and his pupils shrank slightly.
"Boss, I'm back."
The big man grinned at Captain Lei and made a muffled sound. When his eyes fell on the food on the table, his eyes lit up. He stepped closer, took off his shield and threw it aside. He then threw the mace in his hand on the ground, making two loud bangs.
After doing this, he sat down directly. The chair suddenly made a thrilling creaking sound, as if the support was extremely reluctant. From the beginning to the end, he did not look at Xu Qing, as if he didn't care very much.
Captain Lei smiled and said nothing. The big man stared at the food without making a move and waited silently.
As for Xu Qing, he looked at the shield and mace on the ground.
From the sounds just now, he could basically tell that the weight of these two items was probably... both far exceeded his own weight.
Not long after, in the silence of the courtyard, two figures appeared on the street outside the bamboo gate, a man and a woman.
The man was a young man, with a long bow on his back and a tall and straight figure. The only thing he had was a cross scar on his face, which seemed to have been forcibly carved by someone. It was shocking and his eyes were particularly sharp.
As for the woman, she was in her thirties and had an ordinary appearance, but her figure was very hot under a tight leather coat, filled with a kind of primitive temptation.
The two walked into the bamboo courtyard and greeted Captain Lei. When they sat on the chairs, the young man with an arched back glanced at Xu Qing, as if he was scrutinizing it.
The woman next to him looked curious, her voice was a little coquettish, and she spoke with a smile.
"Boss, why did you have an extra child when we went out? Boss, is it possible that you called us back this time to tell everyone that you kept a seed outside without telling us?"
"The age is wrong." The burly man said dullly.
Xu Qing didn't say anything. He moved his left foot slightly so that the dagger tied to his calf could be taken out more smoothly. He was a little uneasy. Each of the three people who arrived gave him a strong feeling.
It was even stronger than Fat Mountain yesterday.
Especially the man with the bowed back gave Xu Qing a faint feeling of needles on his back.
"Barbarian ghost, body trainingThird level, innate divine power. " Captain Lei ignored their jokes, glanced at Xu Qing, and pointed at the burly man.
"Luan Ya has the third level of Qi Condensation and can communicate with ferocious beasts. Most of the wild dogs you see in this camp are her eyes and ears. "
"Cross, the fourth level of Qi Condensation is perfect, there is no opponent in the same situation. "Lei Dui finished speaking to Xu Qing one by one, and then pointed at Xu Qing in front of the three of them.
"Child, second level of body training. "
As Captain Lei spoke, the three members of the team all looked more solemn. Xu Qing sat aside and listened carefully.
“Eat first and talk while eating. "Looking at the four people, Captain Lei spoke calmly, picked up a small piece of meat, and ate it.
"This time I called you back in advance because this year's spring harvest is ahead of schedule. The camp leader has issued a task. In addition to the original purchase price of the seven-leaf clover, the party with the most will be given three additional Qingchen Pills that are far more effective than white pills! "
"The piece of land we have hidden in the restricted area can be picked in advance. What do you think? "As soon as Captain Lei said these words, the three barbarian ghosts all had sparkles in their eyes. After looking at each other, they all nodded.
Xu Qing had never heard of the Qingchen Pill, but Captain Lei's words made it very clear that this pill was more effective than the Bai Pill.
"Since you agree, let's get ready. When entering the restricted area this time, the children will follow. "Lei Dui said slowly.
"Him? "The three barbarian ghosts looked at Xu Qing.
At the cross, he frowned slightly.
"Boss, the second level of body refining is too weak. It would be inappropriate for us to take care of it while completing the task. "
